recordingSetup.title: This meeting's setup
recordingSetup.description: Adjustments are written only to the new meeting snapshot and never modify the template. Unconfirmed people help name recognition but are not counted as attendees.
recordingSetup.lockedDescription: Recording has started, so the people and terminology snapshot is locked to keep recognition rules consistent.
recordingSetup.loadWarning: The template or preset could not be loaded. Recording remains available but may start without people context.

recordingSetup.invalidDraft: This meeting's people or terminology setup has incomplete or conflicting values. Fix them before recording.
recordingSetup.noPreset: This template has no people and terminology preset. Recording and summary generation remain available.
recordingSetup.attendanceHelp: Template members start as “Attending” — just switch the people who did not show up to “Absent”. “Expected” people are recognition candidates only; only confirmed attendance, absence, and host are summary facts.
recordingSetup.filterNoMatch: No people match the filter. Clear it to see everyone.
recordingSetup.guestsHelp: Guests apply only to this meeting and are not added to the template.
recordingSetup.termsHelp: Project names, abbreviations, or common misrecognitions that apply only to this meeting.
